description: Wire mcp_traffic_fingerprints.py library module into mcp_scanner daemon for MCP protocol confirmation during candidate server scanning. Must use write_service (port 8772) for DB access, not direct duckdb. Scanner calls detect_mcp_methods() and is_mcp_traffic() from fingerprint library on HTTP responses. Integration adds evidence to candidate server metadata. Do NOT rebuild mcp_scanner.py or mcp_traffic_fingerprints.py - both are ALREADY_BUILT. Only add the wiring/consumer logic.
